title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode4 Our Strengths Combined

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: A few days later
Civic Center - Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... That's everything the costume designers will be doing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all for your time. I know this probably felt like an eternity, but we've covered the actors, composers, band, art team, lighting and costume groups' tasks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does anyone have any questions?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Okay, if no one has any questions, then I'd like to end this planning meeting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you all again for coming today.
Let's do our best to make our show a good one.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Nice work, leader!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks. I was so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Costume Designer
rows.Line:
This is such a great story!
I can't wait to start designing the costumes for it!

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line: How do you guys wanna design the set?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so relieved that I was able to get enough people, and hold this planning meeting...)
Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Hoshino...!
And the rest of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all again for agreeing to help on such short notice. I know I sorta invited you out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, thank you for thinking of us.
Let's do our best to make this musical a really good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What she said!
We have to do our absolute best, after Airi went out of her way to tell us about this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
But I am a little nervous. This is pretty different from what we normally do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino's going to be acting, Tenma's writing songs, Mochizuki's on set design, and you're going to be in the band, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was a little surprised to hear that you're going to join the set designers, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Emu invited me.
Also, a person from one of the other schools already volunteered to play the drums...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Let's all do our best.
I'll work on my acting, too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I know you've all been really busy since going pro.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that!
Our record company has already given us the green light♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
They said official school events are fine, so there's no need for you to worry about us.
Huh?
se_walk_women_005_1
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, no wonder it's so lively over here. Look at all these familiar faces!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi, Shii! We haven't seen each other since breakfast♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ugh... Hi, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you also participating, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Airi invited our entire group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Haruka and Minori won't be joining us. They're scheduled to work right when we'll be preparing for it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, we plan on working extra hard in their place.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, let's do our best together.
Which team have you decided to join?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be designing costumes with Mizuki and the others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Just wait, Shii. I'm going to make you the cutest costume.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think the band needs cute costumes for this...
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu.
Oh, you brought Shinonome with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Thank you very much for agreeing to help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I really wasn't expecting you to join, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, how could I say no to Emu's smiling face?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe!
Let's make the best, sparkliest, most wonderhoy set ever♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd like to take this opportunity to thank you all again for agreeing to help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you, and I promise to do my best to make this show a good one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We have a cast, songwriters, a band, set and costume designers now. There's a ton of things to keep track of...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But with all of us working together, it's sure to turn out great...!)
